study: Blinded eBOSS DR16 LRG full-catalogue sector-metadata consistency audit
stage: Four-field sector-only catalogue audit; no new selection, veto union or pair estimators
permitted_aggregate_outputs: total rows and distinct numeric sector-label count; do not output individual sector IDs
aggregate per-column finite count, minimum, median, maximum, exact zero, above 1 and <=0.5 counts (no cuts)
aggregate per-sector nonconstant column counts under fixed absolute tolerance
aggregate equality and absolute-difference diagnostics for three explicitly fixed candidate formulae; no choosing one after inspecting data
per_sector_grouping: Use exact published integer SECTOR label only. Print aggregate counts, never sector IDs or one row per sector.
failure_rules: Prior byte-only local JSON SHA differs from uploaded frozen copy
Any official FITS full-file/header SHA, byte count, BINTABLE structure or named column FITS format differs
Any non-finite sector numeric column values; do not silently impute
Any unsupported FITS column format or computed row stride mismatch
Any attempted decoding of other observed FITS columns or odd statistics
interpretation: Check only structural constancy and candidate numeric relations on published full-catalogue rows. It is NOT an independent historical MANGLE pipeline validation, identification of C_eBOSS and C_z, authorized completeness cut or validation of published clustering random selection.
published_reference: Ross et al., MNRAS 498 (2020) 2354, section 5.2 / veto table; Zhao et al., MNRAS 503 (2021) 1149, matched EZmock sector handling
